questions.qtext: Let L1 and L2 are formal languages which of the following options are decidable.

options.text: If L1 and L2 are regular, they can have different minimal DFA’s, if L1 = L2.
If L1 is regular, L2 is DCFL L′ = L1 ∩ L2, L′ is closed under subset.
If L2 is CFL and L1 is regular L′ = L2 – L1′, L′ = is decidable.

questions.solution:
(a, c)
(a) Two equal regular languages have same minimal DFA - trivial thing decidable.
(b) L′ = Reg ∩ DCFL = DCFL not closed under subset.
(c) L′ = CFL – (Reg)′ = CFL closed under emptiness of language.
